5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.zh: 歐洲疫情更新,多國自去(2025)年12月截至今年5月中旬累計報告至少83例病例,其中至少20例住院,病患以兒童及年輕人為多,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疫情分布於丹麥、匈牙利、捷克、法國等9個歐洲國家,經調查疑感染源為雞肉相關產品,受影響國家已要求廠商將相關產品下架。
5LBFvc7xv1IXgS17Ed6VcQ.en: European outbreak update: between December 2025 and mid-May 2026, multiple countries reported at least 83 cases, of which at least 20 were hospitalised. Cases are mainly among children and young people. Genotyping identified Salmonella Stanley ST2045. The outbreak is spread across nine European countries, including Denmark, Hungary, Czechia and France. Investigations suggest the suspected source is chicken-related products, and affected countries have asked manufacturers to withdraw the products from the market.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

gMS68mUFR5VmI18yfaw-lA.zh: 美國及丹麥等9個歐洲國家今年截至5/12累計報告62例病例,病患多為兒童及年輕人,多數需住院治療,基因分型顯示型別為Salmonella Stanley ST2045,疑為單一食物來源感染,各國當局仍持續調查感染來源。 美國5/12報告37例病例,其中多數需住院治療,病患分布於12個州,經當局調查,疑感染源為某生產商之奶粉相關產品,產品已要求下架。
gMS68mUFR5VmI18yfaw-lA.en: The United States and nine European countries including Denmark have reported 62 cases this year as of 12 May. Most patients are children and young people, and most required hospitalisation. Genotyping shows Salmonella Stanley ST2045, which is suspected to be infection from a single food source; authorities in each country continue to investigate the source. On 12 May, the United States reported 37 cases, most requiring hospitalisation, distributed across 12 states. An investigation by authorities suspects a milk powder-related product from a certain manufacturer as the source, and the product has been asked to be withdrawn.

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.zh: 疫情更新:  人類疫情:今年累計報告H5N1流感5例、H9N2流感12例及H10N3流感1例,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計56國家/地區報告3,303起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共15國於2026/3/11-4/30期間報告439起H5N1疫情,德國361起、智利18起、南韓14起、波蘭13起、泊爾7起、法國5起、美國/臺灣各4起、加拿大3起、丹麥/奧地利/挪威/荷蘭各2起、柬埔寨/義大利各1起。 南韓於2026/4/29報告4起H5N9疫情。 美國乳牛感染禽流感自2024年3月迄今累計20州報告1,093起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州/威斯康辛/加州;該國廢水監測於2026/4/19-25共425個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,紐澤西/伊利諾/馬里蘭/麻薩諸塞州共11個採檢點檢出H5陽性。
1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

HBHQhQjAusE2x0Tq6vRSpQ.zh: 丹麥於今年2/27獲WHO認證為第一個消除先天性梅毒的歐洲國家,該國2024年累計報告626例梅毒病例,其中逾500例為男性。另全球研究顯示,2015-25年梅毒發生率持續攀升,並以北美洲、歐洲及亞洲明顯增加,其中,2022年新增報告8百萬例梅毒病例及70萬例先天性梅毒病例。
HBHQhQjAusE2x0Tq6vRSpQ.en: On 27 February this year, Denmark was certified by WHO as the first European country to eliminate congenital syphilis. In 2024, the country reported 626 cumulative syphilis cases, of which more than 500 were men. Global research shows that syphilis incidence has continued to rise from 2015 to 2025, with significant increases in North America, Europe and Asia. In 2022, 8 million new syphilis cases and 700,000 congenital syphilis cases were reported.

1zdH_cM4IxveWOJLEvJ_ZA.zh: 丹麥於7/14-9/13累計報告57例病例,其中約半數住院,病患年齡介於2-89歲;當局評估實際感染約上百人,疑感染源為雞肉,另2024年累計報告5,546例。
1zdH_cM4IxveWOJLEvJ_ZA.en: Denmark reported 57 cumulative cases from 14 July to 13 September, about half of whom were hospitalized; patients are aged 2 to 89 years. Authorities estimate that the actual number of infections is about a hundred. The suspected source is chicken meat. Denmark reported 5,546 cases cumulatively in 2024.

sFWZgSEYQp5JJnrqt9Ejcw.zh: 丹麥自5月迄今累計報告12例病例,感染同一株新型變異株,年齡介於20-60歲之間,病患居住於不同地區;丹麥最早於2024年5月首次監測到新型變種隱孢子蟲,且僅在該國出現,當局調查先前病例疑感染源為蔬菜及沙拉。
sFWZgSEYQp5JJnrqt9Ejcw.en: Denmark has cumulatively reported 12 cases since May, all infected with the same new variant strain. The patients are aged 20–60 years and live in different regions. Denmark first detected the new Cryptosporidium variant in May 2024, and it has so far appeared only in Denmark. Authorities investigating earlier cases suspect vegetables and salads as the source.

Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.zh: 法國自6月截至8/13累積報告18例病例,其中2例死亡,病患年齡介於34-95歲間,比利時、丹麥、荷蘭、挪威亦檢出相關案例;當局已下架疑感染源(牛/羊奶起司),惟該產品已銷往全球32個國家/地區,包含鄰近之香港、日本及韓國。
Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.en: France has reported 18 cases since June, as of 13 August, of which 2 died; patients are aged 34–95 years. Related cases have also been detected in Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway. Authorities have withdrawn the suspected source, a cheese made from cow's and sheep's milk, but the product has been sold to 32 countries and regions, including neighbouring Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea.

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共8國於2025/2/17-4/28期間新增52起H5N1疫情,美國17起、韓國12起、英國11起、德國/波蘭各4起、匈牙利2起、孟加拉/丹麥各1起。 共2國於2025/3/17-4/11期間新增2起H5N5疫情,挪威/英國各1起。 日本於2025/4/25新增1起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,048 (17)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第17週計407個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、奧勒岡州、紐澤西州)5個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC於5月2日更新流感風險評估工具(IRAT),將兩種新H5N1病毒列入評估名單:A/California/147/2024(基因型B3.13)及A/Washington/239/2024(基因型D1.1),兩病毒均屬H5N1 2.3.4.4b群,並被評為「中度風險」,近於先前被評估之其他 H5N1病毒。 期刊於4/28評論,來自40多國專家呼籲各國應加強監測、增強生物安全及新興傳染病整備計畫,以應對H5N1流感威脅,美國自2024年迄今超過995起乳牛場疫情及至少70例人類病例,並包含多起重症及該國首例死亡病例,部分人類病例未曾接觸感染動物,顯示病毒可能發生適應,並具有人際傳播潛力,另病毒持續於野鳥、家禽及被狩獵候鳥中傳播,亦增加人類及家畜風險。持續投入人畜監測資源,即時分享現地異常資訊及病毒基因學資料,對於掌握病毒動態至關重要。  年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例。) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,656起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.
